# Fixtures

- `oms/2026-01/` — excerpts of the real `mapping.zip` and `SimpleTabulation-ICD-11-MMS-pt.zip`,
  in their literal format (tab, CRLF), for tests without network. Copied from `cid-ponte`
  (`fixtures/oms/`, generated by `scripts/make_fixtures.py`).
- `golden-2026-01.json` — cid-ponte's answers over those excerpts, in this project's field names.
  The bridge must reproduce it exactly.
